note: How far past its budget each renderer is today. These numbers may shrink and may not grow. The one exception on this record: the total was raised deliberately from 422 to 694 for the 2.4.0 release. Raising it is the check declining to do its job, so it is written down rather than absorbed. 164 of the 272 are timepicker/timepicker-clock.component.ts, which gained a two-ring face, a ghost hand that follows the pointer, the dimmed stretches a granularity removes, and the granularity itself. That is drawing, and drawing is a renderer's own work. What this budget exists to catch is a renderer restating logic the contract already holds, and nobody has read these 272 lines one at a time to say which is which. Until someone has, the number is an accepted debt with a name on it, not a measurement of health.
